cases.workflow: Choose a contingent supply contract under correlated outages

data.text: Demand is 100 units, value $20 per unit delivered, no salvage. Select exactly two different supplier contracts and pay their fixed fees in every scenario. For each scenario, benchmark is the best net value obtainable by selecting any two contracts before that scenario and optimizing exercise. cases.workflow: Reconcile invoice lines against receipts and approved substitutions

data.text: Invoice each PO line separately. Received quantities come from unique posted receipt IDs, minus unique posted returns. Duplicate identical IDs are counted once. A signed substitution allows SKU Y receipts to count toward PO SKU X at two Y units per X equivalent. Ignore draft substitutions. Match quantities in X equivalents; do not move surplus across PO lines. First calculate quantity_matched_equivalents=min(net received equivalents, invoiced equivalents, ordered equivalents), independently of price validation. Report held_equivalents=max(0,invoiced equivalents-quantity_matched_equivalents): this field measures quantity shortfall only, not the units whose payment is blocked by a price dispute. Keep that same quantity shortfall even on a price-disputed line; do not set quantity_matched_equivalents to zero because the price is wrong. Separately, unit price must equal the signed PO price. A mismatching price gives reason price_dispute and payable_dollars=0 for the whole line. Otherwise gross payable is quantity_matched_equivalents times the signed PO price. Subtract already-posted credit amounts on that line once, floor at zero; repeated credit IDs are deduplicated. If price matches, reason is short_receipt when held_equivalents>0, otherwise matched. Return deduplicated_record_ids as the sorted distinct IDs that occurred more than once within the receipt rows, return rows, or credit rows; exclude IDs that appeared only once. Report payable_dollars, held_equivalents and reason per line, total_payable_dollars, and deduplicated_record_ids.

cases.workflow: Calculate legally permitted intercompany netting and settlement

data.text: Only same-currency invoices whose payer and payee both belong to the signed netting pool may be netted. Eliminate identical duplicate invoice IDs; exclude void invoices. Positive pool position means net receivable; negative means payable. Process currencies in ascending currency-code order. Settle by ascending debtor ID then ascending creditor ID, each transfer min(debtor remaining, creditor remaining). Invoices outside a valid pool remain gross obligations. Compute each entity/currency funding requirement=max(0,net pool payable + gross outside-pool payable - freely available cash in that currency). Pool receivables are not available to fund outside obligations until settlement and therefore do not reduce funding needs. Cash must not be converted across currencies, restricted balances are excluded. Return positions keyed ENTITY:CURRENCY for pool members, ordered settlement IDs as PAYER>PAYEE:CURRENCY:AMOUNT, gross_obligation_ids, funding_dollars by entity/currency (amounts in currency units), total_external_usd_dollars using locked FX only for reporting.

cases.workflow: Solve a refinancing cash waterfall and leverage cap

data.text: Choose one loan quote. Principal P is an integer multiple of $10,000 and at least enough to repay old debt. Loan fee = fixed_fee + fee_bps*P/10000; capitalized fee is included in reported gross debt D=P+fee. Available cash after closing = opening_free_cash + P - old_debt - closing_cost - fee. Distributable cash = cash minus minimum_cash, cannot be negative. New debt annual interest = interest_bps*D/10000, paid from annual operating cash. Leverage must satisfy D <= 3*(base_earnings + allowed_synergies), where allowed_synergies=min(proposed_synergies, (base_earnings+allowed_synergies)/5). Covenant uses the final capped earnings. Also interest cannot exceed annual_operating_cash. Maximize distributable cash under both gates; then minimize annual interest; then quote ID, then P. Ignore unsigned indicative quotes. Report loan_id, principal_dollars, fee_dollars, gross_debt_dollars, allowed_synergies_dollars, leverage_limit_dollars, annual_interest_dollars, distributable_cash_dollars. All data yield integral outputs.

cases.workflow: Build a constant-currency recurring-revenue cohort bridge

data.text: Opening cohort consists of customers active at opening with positive opening annual recurring revenue (ARR), excluding acquired customers. For these same customers classify end ARR: churn if inactive at end, otherwise expansion or contraction relative to opening ARR, at fixed opening FX. A reactivated customer with zero opening ARR is new/reactivated, not retained opening cohort. Acquired end ARR is reported separately and excluded from organic bridge. Opening cohort ARR and end organic ARR use opening FX; end reported ARR uses closing FX. Net dollar retention bps=floor(end ARR of opening cohort / opening cohort ARR *10000). Gross retention excludes expansion (sum(min(opening,end) for opening cohort)/opening ARR) rounded down bps. Organic bridge must reconcile opening + expansion - contraction - churn + new/reactivated. FX effect is end total reported minus end total at opening FX. Use the signed customer-status register, not the sales draft.

cases.workflow: Reconcile earnings to sustainable free cash flow

data.text: Start with reported EBITDA. Approved exceptional expense addbacks raise adjusted EBITDA but do not automatically change cash. A cash-paid exceptional item remains in operating cash; exclude it from sustainable operating cash only by adding it back once. A noncash exceptional item is already added in the noncash bridge and must not be added again. Operating cash = reported EBITDA + noncash expense adjustments - cash_taxes - cash_interest - increase_AR - increase_inventory + increase_AP, with FX-only AR change removed from increase_AR. Capitalized recurring maintenance must be reclassified from reported growth_capex into maintenance_capex; total capex cash unchanged. Sustainable operating cash = operating cash + cash-paid approved exceptional addbacks. Sustainable FCF = sustainable operating cash - maintenance_capex after reclassification (growth capex excluded). Cash conversion bps = floor(sustainable FCF/adjusted EBITDA*10000). Recommend investigate if conversion below 6000 bps, otherwise acceptable; do not infer fraud from the calculation. Reported AR change includes the FX-only component.

cases.workflow: Determine safe recovery from overlapping leader leases

data.text: Normalize local event time to coordinator time by subtracting the host offset.
